text: Hi! I matriculated in AY2025/26 as a Computer Science student and I'm about to start Year 2 Semester 1. So far I've completed CS1101S, CS1231S, MA1521 and MA1522. I want to do the Artificial Intelligence focus area, and I definitely want to take CS3263 at some point. I'll be on a 6-month internship in Year 3 Semester 2, so no classes then. I'd like between 16 and 20 units each semester. Can you plan the rest of my degree?

I'm a CS student who matriculated in AY2025/26, and I'm about to start Year 4 Semester 1. I've completed CS1101S, CS1231S, CS2030S, CS2040S, CS2100, CS2101, CS2103T, CS2109S, MA1521, MA1522, CS3219 and CS4218. My focus area is Software Engineering. I'll be interning full-time in Year 4 Semester 2, so no classes then. Because I work part-time, I can only take between 4 and 8 units a semester. Please plan my remaining semesters.
why: CS2106, CS3230 and ST2334 (12 units) are still required, but only semester 7 is open and it allows at most 8 units.
